name: 13317 · Canajoharie, NY
findings: ZIP 13317 (Canajoharie) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13317 (Canajoharie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13317 (Canajoharie) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
